column1: # The fate of every file of today's build (STANDALONE-PLAN §15.4; PlanSwap-4). Read by fates.ts,
# which says what each field means; checked by fates.test.ts and the fence (fence.test.ts).
# Every file under src/backend, src/frontend, src/shared, src/engine, src/packs, src/cli and
# src/worker, and src/backend.ts, src/frontend.ts and src/spindle-augment.ts, has one line, settled by
# its path and never by its name. A package that adds a file under those folders adds its line; one
# that moves or removes a file keeps its line, so the list ends as the report of which went (R-50).
# Made on 15 Nov from the exact import graph (the fence's reader, equal edge for edge to
# `tsc --explainFiles` over src/, test/ and scripts/) and Bun's metafile of the shipped entries. Each
# removed file of src/shared, src/engine and src/packs is one that nothing kept reaches; each kept
# one is reached from a kept item without passing through a removed file.
